title: Unfocused shock waves for osteoinduction in bone substitutes
author: Marianne Koolen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pv5dn86
materials:
vascularization and bone ingrowth (see attachment: tabel studiegroepen
en tijdslijn).
Vascularization is examined with microCT angiography and histological
analysis. This will be done at 2 weeks after implantation and at 9 weeks
after implantation (n=8 animals per group).
With microCT angiography a radiopaque contrast agent is infused in the
vascular system. To do this sequential solutions with heparin, saline and
formalin are injected through the abdominal aorta. Finally a lead chromate
radiopaque contrast agent (Microfil MV-122, Flow Tech, Carver, MA) is
infused. This contrast agent is left in situ and will polymerize at room
temperature. After 24 hours microCT scans are made and
three-dimensional morphology of the blood vessels in the bone
substitutes (vessel volume, number of vessels, mean vessel thickness,
connectivity) are analyzed.
Hereafter, samples will be decalcified for histological analysis. Microfil will
become a rubber and therefore sectioning and histological analysis is still
possible. Hematoxylin/eosin and thionine staining will be performed to
examine new bone formation and general morphology. Furthermore,
immune histochemistry with Von Willebrand factor and CD-31 will be
performed to further examine angiogenesis and new vessel formation.
Bone ingrowth is analyzed during 9 week follow-up with in vivo microCT
scanning (n=8 per group) and fluorochrome labelling at 0, 3, 6 and 8,5
weeks. MicroCT scanning allows three-dimensional analysis of bone
ingrowth in the bone substitutes during follow-up in high detail. At 0, 3, 6
and 9 weeks a scan of the femur with the implant is made under
anesthesia. Since the density of bone is the same as the density of TCP
and HA is scaffolds it is not possible to discriminate bone and the bone
substitute. However, individual rats are followed in time with in vivo
microCT scanning. Matched reconstructions do therefore specifically
show areas with new bone formation and areas with bone resorption. To
examine bone ingrowth in porous titanium special segmentation
techniques have been developed to reduce metal artifacts. After 9 weeks
animals will be euthanized and micrOCT angiography and histology will
be performed as described above. With fluorochrome labelling we can
also follow the bone formation over time and we could compare this to
microCT scanning to make it more accurate.
We have wide experience with all the above-mentioned techniques. We
perform in vivo microCT scanning in rats for over ten years. The RatFix
system is used for three years now in our lab and we have performed
more than hundred of such procedures. MicroCT angiography with
Microfil is a more novel technique, which we have acquired ourselves last
half year. Fluorochrome labelling is used for multiple years now,
especially in the UMC Utrecht there is a lot of experience with this type of
analysis.
Effect and outcome variables:
New vessel formation is analyzed with ex vivo microCT angiography, as
explained above. The total volume of vessels, number of vessels, mean
vessel thickness, connectivity and distance of penetration in the bone
substitute are analyzed.
Total bone volume in the defect is measured. For TCP and HA the volume
of the scaffold (volume at t=0) is subtracted from the bone volume in
follow-up scans. In porous titanium both total bone volume as bone
volume within the pores is analyzed. Hence, the research question is
whether UESWT improves bone ingrowth in the bone substitute and we
are not primarily interested in the differences between different bone
substitutes.
Furthermore, if eligible specific cell numbers can be analyzed on histology,
and especially with fluorochrome labelling bone growth over time can be
visualized.
Methods for taking measurements:
Analysis of blood vessels is performed with microCT angiography. This is
performed at 2 weeks after implantation and at the endpoint of the study.
The reason to analyze this early after implantation is that it is believed that
angiogenesis is an early phase in the onset of bone regeneration.
5

With in vivo microCT scanning at 0, 3, 6 and 9 weeks, bone ingrowth is
analyzed and also with fluorochrome labelling at 0, 3, 6, and 8,5 weeks (0
and 1,5 weeks for the early group).
Methods for data management and analysis (including biostatistical
check):
All microCT data, both for blood vessel and for bone analysis, CtAnalyzer
is used. End results are transported to Excell and Graphpad Prism to
perform statistical data analyses. To analyze differences between UESW
treated and non-UESW treated controls all parameters are statistically
analyzed with t-tests for each bone substitute.
Animal model:
Sixteen-week-old male Wistar rats are used. A single dose of antibiotics
(terramycin, 25 mg/kg body weight) is administered 30 minutes before
surgery. Under aseptical conditions and under general anesthesia (1,5–2%
isoflurane in air) the procedure is performed. The femur is exposed
though a lateral incision of the skin and division of the underlying fascia. A
23 mm long PEEK plate (RatFix, AO Foundation, Davos, Switzerland) to
the anterolateral plane of the femur is fixed. Three proximal and three
distal screws fix the plate. The periostium is removed over some 8 mm of
the mid- diaphysis before removal of the 6 mm long bone segment. The
segment is removed with a tailor-made saw guide and a wire saw (RatFix,
AO Foundation), and the bone substitute is placed press-fit into the defect
site. The fascia and skin are sutured in layers. UESWT is or is not
performed hereafter. A gel is applied over the femur and then the shock
wave applicator is gently placed on the femur and 1000 shock waves are
applied with light continuous deviation of the applicator. Prophylactic pain
medication (buprenorphine, 0.05 mg/kg body weight) is administered just
before operation and then three times a day for the first 3 days after
surgery. Euthanasia is performed after 2 or 9 weeks with in intra-cardiac
overdose with pento-barbital. All other procedures are performed after
euthanasia. Either 1,5 week after the operation or 3, 6 and 8,5 weeks
fluorochrome labelling is injected subcutaneous (Xylenol orange 100
mg/kg, calceine 25 mg/kg, terramycin 25 mg/kg). Opzet van de studie Doel/Hypothese Hypothese
We hypothesize that UESW stimulate angiogenesis and bone ingrowth in
orthotopic implanted bone substitutes and thus that UESW treatment can
be of benefit for patients who receive bone substitutes, because it might
lead to higher union rates with less re-operations and quicker recovery
with earlier weight bearing of the injured site.
Aim:
The aim of the study is to examine if UESW stimulate bone ingrowth in
orthotopic implanted bone substitutes in a large bone defect model in rats.
It is a translational study with a very straightforward set-up that is strongly
related to the clinics. This set-up has been chosen such that, dependent
on the outcome of course, it can directly lead to clinical follow-up studies.
ESWT is already used and approved for clinical use in non-unions and
wound healing and its safety has been proven. Therefore clinical follow-up
studies can realistically be established, as we currently do with the
application of UESWT in osteoporosis. Wetenschappelijk belang See background Maatschappelijk belang Large bone defects and non-unions lead to high morbidity in patients that
are often young. Often multiple reconstructive procedures are needed
before union is achieved or worse, amputation is carried out. It is
estimated that worldwide 2.2 million bone grafting procedures are carried
out each year. Concepts to increase the success rates of these surgical
procedures will certainly lead to an increase in quality in life in these
patients. Furthermore, such concepts will help to reduce the economic
burden that is involved with these disabling conditions and high

5. Omschrijving van vraagstelling, doel en
belang van dit voorgestelde onderzoek: Achtergrond van de studie Background: Human’s capacity for bone regeneration is unfortunately
limited. In normal circumstances fracture healing will happen uneventfully,
but if biological circumstances hamper full bone regeneration, e.g. in
infectious or non-vital tissue, or when the bone defects are too large to be
bridged, e.g. after major trauma or tumor resection, then non-unions and
osseous defects will develop. These reconstructive challenges are often
seen in orthopedic and cranio-maxillo-facial surgery. The gold standard
for this is treatment with autologous bone grafting. The transplanted bone
serves as a scaffold and will be integrated in the host tissue. The
presence of living cells and growth factors in the donor bone further
support the attraction of blood vessels and bone regeneration.
Unfortunately supplies are limited and morbidity at the donor site,
including post-operative pain, chronic pain, hematoma, infections, and
other complications are seen in 8-39%. Therefore there is a need for
alternative strategies.
One of these strategies is with bone substitutes. There are many different
bone substitutes. Demineralized bone matrix and collagen polymers are
examples of biological substitutes. Porous metals, bioactive glass,
calcium sulphates and calcium phosphates are examples of synthetic
substitutes. The use of these bone substitutes has expanded greatly
during the last decade, i.a. because they are ready-to-use and easy
applicable. It is mainly used for filling of metaphyseal defects or
stabilization of unstable fracture and supportive results have been
described in fractures of the proximal femur, calcaneus, proximal and
distal tibia, distal radius and vertebrae.
Each bone substitute has other properties concerning osteoconductivity,
osteoinductivity, structural support, biocompatibility and resorbability. The
ideal bone substitute possesses al these features, but unfortunately this
bone substitute does not exist. For instance, trabecular metals can offer
direct structural support, but are non-resorbable and are not
osteoinductive, and calcium sulphates are easily resorbed, but lack
mechanical support and are not osteoinductive either. The mostly used
bone substitutes nowadays are with calcium phosphates, because they
have good biocompatibility and provide some mechanical support. They
exist as tricalcium phosphate (TCP), hydroxy apatite (HA) or a
3

steps.title: combination of both
steps.instruction:
combination of both. TCP is rather quickly resorbed and hydroxy apatite is
hardly resorbed.
Major drawback of bone substitutes is that they lack osteoinductive
properties. As exception calcium phosphates do have some
osteoinductive properties, which are likely related to calcium and
phosphate ions that are released after degradation. However, these
osteoinductive properties are very limited and, as said, these are
completely lacking in other bone substitutes. Therefore various
mechanisms have been tried to load the substitute with certain growth
factors to stimulate angiogenesis and osteogenesis, e.g. BMP-2, VEGF,
IGF-I, FGF-2, TGF-beta116,18. However, timing of the right growth factor
in the right amount is important because angiogenesis, vascularization,
the attraction of bone forming and resorbing cells and osteogenesis all
take place at different time points during regeneration. And since in vivo
bone regenerative events is an interplay between many growth factors
and many cell types which is not orchestrated by one or two growth
factors it is unlikely that this is the optimal approach to induce
osteoinductive properties in bone substitutes.
In earlier work, examining alternative strategies for the treatment of
osteoporosis than today’s pharmaceutical treatment, we found that a
single treatment with unfocused extracorporeal shockwaves result in
distinct de novo bone formation. There is increasing evidence that
extracorporeal shock wave treatment stimulates both angiogenesis and
osteogenesis and it is therefore increasingly applied in avascular necrosis,
myocardial infarction, non-union and wound healing. It has been shown
that various growth factors, including TGF-beta1, BMP-2, -3, -4, -7 and
VEGF, are stimulated after treatment. This biophysical stimulus is much
more potent than other (more familiar) biophysical stimuli like ultrasound,
mechanical vibrations and pulsed electro-magnetic fields. Major drawback,
and in contrast to other biophysical stimuli, is that application of shock
waves is painful and anesthesia during treatment is necessary. However,
since both angiogenesis and osteogenesis is stimulated by several growth
factors it might be a superior approach to stimulate bone ingrowth in bone
substitutes than adding certain growth factors.
Research plan:
-Study subjects, specimen or materials:
We will use 16-week-old male Wistar rats. With use of AO’s RatFix
system we create a 6mm femoral defect, which is stabilized by six
bicortical screws and an internal PEEK plate. The bone defect is filled with
one of the following bone substitutes:
1. ChronOS™- this is a porous ?-tricalcium phosphate (TCP) with
100-500 microm pore size and 70% porosity (manufactured by Synthes,
Oberdorf, Switzerland)
2. Endobon®- this is a porous hydroxyapatite (HA) with 100-1.500 microm
pore size and 45-85%porosity (manufactured by Biomet, Warsaw, Indiana)
3. porous titanium produced from Ti6Al4V with selective laser melting –
this has a pore size of 240-730 microm and a porosity of 88%
(manufactured by Layerwise, Leuven, Belgium)
TCP and HA are chosen because these are momentarily the most often
used bone substitutes in the clinincs. Porous titanium is a novel bone
substitute that gives direct structural support and might therefore be used
more often in the future in large bone defects.
These three groups will be subdivided in a group that does and a group
that does not receive a treatment with UESW. If UESW are applied this
will be at the end of the surgical procedure so after the skin is closed.
When the animal is still anesthetized 1000 shock waves with an EFD of
0.3 mJ/mm2 will be applied to the femur. The focal area of the shock
waves is 3.8 cm so the bone defect with the bone substitute and also the
distal and proximal femoral bone is treated, also because during
treatment the applicator is deviated continuously. This will take
approximately 6 minutes. The animals that do not receive UESWT serve
as control.
In total there are six groups (three different bone substitutes that will
receive UESWT and three that will not receive UESWT). Sixteen animals
per group will be examined, so 96 in total. Two features are examined:
4

steps.title: demanding procedures
steps.instruction:
demanding procedures.
UESWT can be an additive on existing procedures to improve bone
regeneration. It is easy applicable, relatively cheap compared to the use
of recombinant growth factors and its safety has been proven. Eigen ethische afweging
(zie vraagteken voor uitleg)
Met dit experiment komen we een stuk dichter bij klinische toepassing en
daarmee een betere kwaliteit van leven voor de beoogde patienten.
Het voorgestelde diermodel is een veel gebruikt en algemeen
geaccepteerd botdefect model in de internationale literatuur aangaande
dit onderwerp. Er worden geen bijkomende risico’s voorspeld, behoudens
de standaard operatie risico’s (oa anesthesie).
De voorgestelde methode en opzet van dit experiment is al vaker
uitgevoerd in het Erasmus Medisch Centrum onder andere door de
verantwoordelijke onderzoeker (van der Stok et al., Tissue Eng Part A,
2013; van der Stok et al., JOR 2013). Er werden geen complicaties
geconstateerd, geen infecties, geen wond dehiscentie of insufficiënte
wondgenezing.
Het ongerief door de ratten bleef daarmee beperkt: dag 1-3 matig/ernstig,
1-12 weken: gering, tijdens scannen gering. Na 12 weken hadden de
ratten een gemiddeld gewicht van ruim 500 gram.
Al deze factoren wegen naar mijn mening op tegen het aantal te
gebruiken dieren en hun ongerief.
6. Lekensamenvatting
(wordt gepubliceerd in het openbare DEC-jaarverslag) Nederlandse titel Botstimulatie in botvervangers met schokgolftherapie Achtergrond Botvervangers worden steeds meer gebruikt bij de behandeling van grote
botdefecten en niet helende botbreuken. Een groot nadeel van deze
botvervangers is echter het ontbreken van de stimulans waardoor
botvoorloper cellen veranderen in botcellen (osteoinductie), die een
belangrijke rol spelen bij de vomring van bot. Dit kan wel gestimuleerd
worden door een (groei)factor toe te voegen, maar botaanmaak is
afhankelijk van meerdere factoren, niet van een of twee factoren.
Schokgolftherapie heeft aangetoond dat het meerdere factoren, die te
maken hebben met botgroei, in een keer stimuleert. Tevens wordt het al
veilig toegepast bij patiënten onder andere om bot aan te maken, maar
ook om vaatgroei te stimuleren. Vaatgroei is een van de andere factoren
die een belangrijke rol spelen bij botvorming. Schokgolftherapie is nog
niet uitgetest bij botvervangers. Doel/hypothese Ontwikkelen van een verbeterde botstimulatie in botvervangers door
gebruik te maken van schokgolftherapie. Globale aanpak vraagstelling
(Inclusief argumentatie waarom de inzet van
proefdieren noodzakelijk is)
We implanteren drie verschillende botvervangers in een bovenbeen van
een rat, nadat we er zes millimeter bot uitgehaald hebben. We
stabiliseren het gat in het bovenbeen door een plaat met schroeven
rondom deze plek op het bovenbeen te zetten. We zullen dan met een
micro CT-scan de botformatie vervolgen over tijd. Tevens kijken we naar
botgroei na de proef door plakjes te snijden van het bot, die kleuren we en
dan kunnen we zien of er bot(cellen) aanwezig is/zijn in en rondom de
botvervangers. Bij deze plakjes kunnen we ook het verloop van de
botgroei over de tijd zien, omdat we gedurende het experiment meerdere
keren verschillende kleuren vloeistof gebruiken die zich binden aan het
bot en dan meegroeien met het nieuw gevormde bot. Op de plakjes
kunnen we dan de lijntjes van de verschillende aan bot gebonden
vloeistoffen zien. Als laatste kijken we naar de vaatgroei omdat dat
belangrijk is voor botgroei. Dit doen we door vloeistof in de vaten te
spuiten, die we dan kunnen zien als we een micro-CT scan maken.
De biologie van botgenezing is op geen enkele wijze na te bootsen,
waardoor er geen goed alternatief is ter vervanging van deze dierproef.

3a. Welke methodologische aspecten zijn
meegenomen om het aantal dieren
(hoeveel per groep en hoeveel groepen)
te berekenen?
Estimation of sample size and power:
We base our power calculation on an earlier study in which we used
porous titanium. The calculation is based on total bone volume because
this is the most important outcome parameter. Previous studies with TCP
within the same research model resulted in much less bone ingrowth and
therefore we base the power analysis on the data with titanium scaffolds.
Total bone volume was around 15 mm3 at 8 weeks with a standard
deviation of almost 5 mm3. We expect that UESWT has a large effect on
bone formation and clinical application of UESWT is only interesting if we
find distinct effects. We expect that the average bone volume is 23 mm3
after UESWT. With alpha=5% and beta=80% we will need 8 animals per
group. So after 2 weeks 8 animals per group are harvested and another 8
animals continue until 9 weeks follow-up. Sixteen animals times six
groups gives a total number of 96 animals.

steps.title: Alternatief
steps.instruction:
Alternatief: verfijning
4a. Welke maatregelen heeft u genomen -
naast de standaardmaatregelen zoals
groepshuisvesting en kooiverrijking - om
het ongerief voor de proefdieren zoveel
mogelijk te beperken (Verfijning)?
1. Op diverse manieren wordt er getracht ongerief te verminderen. De
operatieve procedure wordt uitgevoerd door een ervaren onderzoeker, die
de procedure reeds vele malen heeft uitgevoerd. Tijdens het experiment
wordt ruime aandacht besteed aan adequate pijnstilling. Zowel
perioperatief als postoperatief (tot 3 dagen) ontvangen de ratten
Temgesic als analgeticum. Daarnaast worden de ratten gedurende de
eerste dagen dagelijks geobserveerd, en in het vervolg van de proef een
maal per week. Verder wordt de eerste micro-CT scan in dezelfde
narcose sessie gedaan als de operatie en behandeling, zodat de ratten
minder vaak hoeven bij te komen uit narcose. En bij elk eindpunt worden
eventuele scans en het toedienen van Microfil in dezelfde narcose sessie
gedaan als de overdosis euthenasol.
2. In het voorgestelde onderzoek wordt een dier uit de proef genomen als
er sprake is van een of meer van de volgende situaties:
• Intraoperatief: optreden van onbehandelbare complicaties zoals een
grote niet te stoppen bloeding, of het ontstaan van een fissuur ten
gevolge van het plaatsen van het osteosynthese materiaal of behandelen.
• Postoperatief: optreden van onbehandelbare wondinfecties (klein risico),
of het niet tot zich nemen van water en voedsel (gewichtsverlies >15% in
twee dagen of >20% tov pre-experimenteel gewicht).
• Het uitbreken van osteosynthese materiaal. Het betreft hier een
theoretische (zeer kleine) kans. Het gebruikte osteosynthese materiaal
(RatFix, AO Foundation) is speciaal ontwikkeld voor gebruik in dit type bot
defect model. Na plaatsing wordt rigide mechanisch belastbare fixatie van
het femur verkregen.
3. De ratten worden gehuisvest volgens de standaard van het ratten
laboratorium. Huisvesting in groepen van twee. Mocht tijdens de
gewenningsperiode blijken dat de ratten niet te handhaven zijn, worden
de ratten alsnog individueel gehuisvest. Verder water en voer ad libitum.

steps.title: en adviseert u tetracyclines te vermijden
steps.instruction:
en adviseert u tetracyclines te vermijden. Dit antibioticum is gekozen omdat het tevens een
fluorochroommarker is waarmee we osseointegratie beoordelen. Indien we dit zouden wijzigen
zouden de dieren twee injecties moeten krijgen. Tevens krijgen alle dieren tetracycline, dus mocht het
intefereren dan zal dit bij elk dier het geval zijn. De mate van interfereren kan natuurlijk per rat
verschillen, maar uit onze ervaring blijkt dat dit minimaal is.
- WP, 6b en 8: De DEC verzoekt u de ongeriefinschatting van de operatie (regel 2 in tabel 6b) aan te
passen naar matig, in plaats van matig/ernstig. Aangepast.
- WP, 7b: De DEC verzoekt u de ongeriefinschatting van de eventuele gevolgen van de operatie aan
te passen naar matig/ernstig, in plaats van gering (dient minimaal gelijk te zijn aan het ongerief
aangegeven in tabel 6b). Niet aangepast, omdat naar mijn mening het ongerief na de operatie minder
is dan de operatie zelf. Irritatie aan de wond is, naar mijn idee, minder ongerief dan een volledige
operatie. Ik ben het er echter wel mee eens dat het totale ongerief (8.) minimaal gelijk moet zijn aan
het ongerief aangegeven in tabel 6b en dat is ook zo.
Met vriendelijke groet,
Marianne Koolen
